acceptance_assessment.engineering: implementation and playback checked separately; does not validate physical accuracy
acceptance_assessment.pixel_evidence: improvement on development observations used for fitting and selection; not an independent final test
acceptance_assessment.geometry: saved blade geometry penetrates the frozen native ice plane
acceptance_assessment.plane_count_definition: Z of saved lower-edge samples under current conditional scene scale; 1 micrometre avoids roundoff. 1 cm is an additional descriptive count, not a pass tolerance. No contact labels inferred.

between_fitted_models.meaning: difference between two fitted models, NOT a measured error or confidence interval

acceptance_assessment.independent_3d_accuracy: unknown: no independent 3D ground truth or frozen final validation set
acceptance_assessment.visual_review_role: source identity and visible anomalies only; user is not asked to judge invisible depth by eye

limitations: Five short development windows only; outside windows replay J1_s2.
Pixel error improvements do not establish depth, physical contact or 3D accuracy.
Assistant source review is not human acceptance; uncertainty and failures are preserved.
Stopping reasons and nonconverged gradients are retained per window.
